title.value: Augmenting Human Selves Through Artificial Agents – Lessons From the Brain
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the paper's focus on enhancing human capabilities through the use of artificial agents by applying lessons derived from studying brain processes.
title.quote: Augmenting Human Selves Through Artificial Agents – Lessons From the Brain

extractions.description: The paper explores the potential of artificial agents to augment human capabilities by leveraging principles from neuroscience, specifically the free energy principle and temporo-spatial dynamics. It discusses the development of adaptive agents that align with both social and environmental contexts, proposing applications such as psychiatric assistance, environmental disaster prediction, and moral decision-making.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily deals with AI and neuroscience concepts aimed at augmenting human capabilities and does not directly address eco-responsible applications or categories related to climate or environmental science.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we focus on how a machine can augment humans rather than do what they do, and we extend this beyond AGI-style tasks to augmenting peculiarly personal human capacities, such as wellbeing and morality.

primary_sub_category.justification: Similar to the primary category, the sub-category is also not applicable since the paper's focus is not directly aligned with any specific eco-responsible sub-categories provided.
primary_sub_category.quote: The targeted applications are broad: from adaptive intelligence augmenting agents (IA’s) that assist psychiatric self-regulation to environmental disaster prediction and personal assistants.

applications.justification: The paper mentions the use of artificial agents in predicting natural disasters, which is one of the applications discussed.
applications.quote: Now let us shift from economy to nature, invoking another scenario. We are living in a world full of catastrophic crises that involve cascades of events in a hierarchy of different time and space scales; these include wildfires, seismic earth waves with earthquakes, flooding, pandemics and storms...

new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on augmenting human capabilities and adaptive AI systems that align with human and environmental contexts, which does not fit into the existing categories.
new_primary_category.quote: Our focus is on how a machine can augment humans rather than do what they do, and we extend this beyond AGI-style tasks to augmenting peculiarly personal human capacities, such as wellbeing and morality.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The integration of neuroscientific principles like the free energy principle and temporo-spatial dynamics into AI systems as discussed in the paper suggests a new sub-category.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: In particular, we suggest conjoining the free energy principle (FEP) with the dynamic temporo-spatial (TSD) view of neuro-mental processes.
